notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-address-commarea (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): ADDRESS COMMAREA and ADDRESS EIB with SET ADDRESS OF. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: eib-view
scenarios.why: ADDRESS EIB then SET ADDRESS OF a view: its fields equal the DFHEIBLK fields

scenarios.name: unknown-mode
scenarios.why: A mode letter no WHEN names: the EVALUATE falls through and the report goes out unchanged

scenarios.name: link-view
scenarios.why: LINK to CAADSB with COMMAREA(WS-AREA) LENGTH(20): the callee's ADDRESS COMMAREA pointer addresses the caller's bytes and its write through SET ADDRESS OF lands in the caller's AD-REPLY

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: Mode N: the task has no COMMAREA (EIBCALEN 0); ADDRESS COMMAREA gives IBM's X'FF000000' and the program reads it through a PIC X(4) view (#7434)
